big_case.notes: Pro se section 1983 suit arising from an Ohio custody dispute, against state trial and juvenile judges, a clerk, a probation officer and a patrolman; dismissed below on Rooker-Feldman, pleading, immunity and futility grounds with prefiling restrictions, affirmed in an unpublished Sixth Circuit order. Response waived and never requested; denied at the first conference with no separate writing. The Rooker-Feldman scope question has some doctrinal interest in the abstract, but this vehicle carries nothing beyond the parties.
